name: Busha Pay WooCommerce Payment Gateway
author: busha

sections.description:
This is a Busha Pay plugin for Woocommerce

To signup for a Busha Pay account visit the website by clicking here

With this Busha Pay WooCommerce Payment Gateway plugin, you will be able to accept the following payment methods in your shop:

  • USDT (Tether)
  • USDC (USD Coin)

Note

This plugin is meant to be used by merchants globally

Plugin Features

  • Accept payment via Stablecoin i.e USDT and USDC
  • Seamless integration into the WooCommerce checkout page. Accept payment directly on your site
  • Refunds from the WooCommerce order details page. Refund an order directly from the order details page

Suggestions / Feature Request

If you have suggestions or a new feature request, feel free to reach out here
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  • Login to your WordPress Admin area
  • Go to “Plugins > Add New” from the left hand menu
  • In the search box type Busha Pay Woocommerce
  • From the search result you will see Busha Pay Woocommerce click on Install Now to install the plugin
  • A popup window will ask you to confirm your wish to install the Plugin.
  • After installation, activate the plugin.
  • Open the settings page for WooCommerce and click the “Checkout” tab.
  • Click on the Busha Pay link from the available Checkout Options
  • Configure your Busha Pay Woocommerce settings. See below for details.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Login to your WordPress Admin. Click on “Plugins > Add New” from the left hand menu.
  3. Click on the “Upload” option, then click “Choose File” to select the zip file from your computer. Once selected, press “OK” and press the “Install Now” button.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Open the settings page for WooCommerce and click the “Checkout” tab.
  6. Click on the Busha Pay link from the available Checkout Options
  7. Configure your Busha Pay Woocommerce settings. See below for details.

Configure the plugin

To configure the plugin, go to WooCommerce > Settings from the left hand menu, then click Checkout from the top tab. You will see Busha as part of the available Checkout Options. Click on it to configure the payment gateway.

  • Enable/Disable – check the box to enable Busha Pay Payment.
  • Title – allows you to determine what your customers will see this payment option as on the checkout page.
  • Description – controls the message that appears under the payment fields on the checkout page. Here you can list the types of assets you accept.
  • Public Key – Go to Profile → Developer Tools → API Tokens, then select Public Key to retrieve it.
  • Secret Key – Profile → Developer Tools → API Tokens, then select Add a new secret token.
  • Webhook Shared Secret – Go to Profile → Developer Tools → Webhook, then select Add a new webhook URL. A secret will be displayed.
  • Click on Save Changes for the changes you made to be effected.
sections.faq:
What Do I Need To Use The Plugin

  1. You need to have WooCommerce plugin installed and activated on your WordPress site.
  2. You need to open a Busha Pay account on Busha
